description: One closed square wooden shipping crate with diagonal bracing and iron corner straps.
One olive-painted rectangular steel military supply chest, sturdy closed lid, metal latches and carrying handles, no weapons or markings.
A compact stack of three weathered wooden freight crates, two on bottom and one above, varied sizes.
One plain rectangular wooden factory mess table, empty plank top and four sturdy legs.
One rectangular steel utility table with dull gray empty top, olive metal legs and lower shelf.
One heavy wooden mechanics workbench with a mounted dark steel vise, a few small hand tools, storage shelf beneath, no backdrop or pegboard.
One olive industrial metal workbench with drawers, scratched steel top, small open tool tray and red oil can.
Exactly ONE upright weathered dark red steel oil barrel, closed circular lid with two bung caps, two reinforcement rings.
A compact cluster of THREE upright weathered steel oil barrels, two dull red and one olive, closed lids with bungs, no platform.

One straight tall solid concrete wall segment, weathered warm gray with tiny chips and seams, thin thickness. Wall follows ground axis from screen lower-left to upper-right. Clear flat ends for modular placement, no corner or return wall.

One straight tall rusted corrugated galvanized metal wall panel held in thin steel frame. Opaque, vertical ribs, muted rust and steel gray. Runs screen lower-left to upper-right along isometric ground axis, no corner or return.
One straight tall old red-brick wall segment, mortar joints, flat top, slight wear. Runs screen lower-left to upper-right along isometric ground axis, flat ends for modular placement, no corner.

One straight chain-link fence segment between two thin steel posts, tightly woven diamond wire clearly see-through with genuine transparent holes showing alpha background. Runs screen lower-left to upper-right along isometric ground axis. No solid panel, no opaque fill or base, no barbed wire.

One straight waist-high industrial iron railing segment, slim upright posts, two thin horizontal rails, wide transparent gaps, blocks passage while allowing visibility. Runs screen lower-left to upper-right along isometric ground axis, no opaque fill or base.
One low compact sandbag barricade stacked three courses high, khaki canvas sacks, straight length along isometric ground axis from lower-left to upper-right.
One low empty weathered wooden shipping pallet, rectangular slats and support blocks.
Compacted dry warm brown earth, fine dusty grit and occasional tiny stones.
Small irregular gray and tan crushed gravel evenly scattered.
Short sparse olive grass with subdued brown soil visible between blades.
Weathered warm gray poured industrial concrete with very fine cracks and subtle stains.
Dark charcoal weathered asphalt with fine gray aggregate, subtle wear, no markings.
Old square gray factory floor tiles with narrow dark mortar lines, slight chips and subdued olive-gray patina. A perfectly regular grid aligned horizontally and vertically.
